name: standard-iid-entity-reservation-audit-20261003
purpose: Prospective, separate-tier scope amendment and identity/rights/schema review. Earlier strict-tier blockers remain preserved evidence, not overwritten.

policy_amendment.effect: Prospective metadata-reservation scope amendment for only Mammographic Mass and Haberman. Not retroactive clearance of the previous stricter-tier decisions or measured cohorts.
policy_amendment.relaxed_condition: Verified patient/entity mapping is not required for this explicitly limited standard-public-IID tier.
unchanged_conditions: Primary permissive data rights and all existing restrictions.
Native targets, reviewed exclusions and no target/test-data leakage.
Rows200-50000, <=200predictors and >=60records per class in source metadata.
Do not discard known group IDs, documented repeat-entity links or mandatory temporal boundaries.
No models, payload acquisition, algorithm freeze or confirmation release authorized by this reservation.

claim_boundary.claim_scope: Row-level standard public IID benchmark evidence only, under explicitly unresolved patient/entity mapping.
claim_boundary.limits: This is not a waiver for known repeat-entity or temporal leakage. If later evidence identifies available group IDs, repeated-entity links or mandatory temporal boundaries, stop and review; do not drop or ignore them to preserve IID eligibility.

policy_amendment.pooling_policy: Separate labels, tables and aggregate denominators from verified-entity cohorts; no pooled patient/entity-independent or clinical claims.

old_strict_tier_decision.target_timing: Native status1 means survival for five years or longer after surgery; status2 means death within five years. Inputs are age at operation, operation year and positive axillary-node count. No different survival horizon or censoring policy is invented.
old_strict_tier_decision.blocker: The inspected source describes cases from a 1958-1970 surgical-patient study, but does not provide a case-to-patient mapping or explicit repeated-operation/one-patient-per-row statement. The additional original-publication metadata supplied no sampling clarification. Numerical eligibility and a patient-oriented description alone are not used to certify the stricter independent-case requirement.
old_strict_tier_decision.minimum_resolution_needed: An original sampling statement establishing one independent index-surgery patient per row, or a reviewed patient/episode mapping and appropriate protocol.
old_strict_tier_decision.not_asserted: No conclusion that records actually repeat; the necessary independence evidence remains unverified.

selected_reviews.remaining_mapping_unknowns: The source describes surgical patient cases but does not verify a one-patient/one-index-operation mapping. Operation year remains a descriptive predictor, not proof of temporal generalization or a supplied longitudinal group index.
selected_reviews.what_changed: User explicitly permits standard public row-IID benchmarking without verified patient/entity mappings in this separately labeled tier. No evidence was invented to resolve the unknown mapping.

primary_license.approval_basis: Reverified explicit original UCI dataset grant. This tier amendment changes permissible benchmark claim scope only; it does not alter licensing or expand deployment/sharing permission.
primary_license.scope: Metadata reservation only now; later local scientific benchmark processing requires explicit restricted-tier freeze/release. No hosted row sharing, reidentification, clinical use or additional redistribution permission.
primary_license.obligations: Credit original contributors/UCI, retain license notices and prominently disclose unresolved entity mapping and retrospective endpoint limits.

class_count_evidence.basis: Original Haberman306-row representation reports225/81 native classes; no labels or data payloads were read.

old_strict_tier_decision.necessary_schema_exclusion: Original source explicitly calls BI-RADS assessment non-predictive. It must not silently enter the predictors. Remaining fields would be Age, Shape, Margin and Density.
old_strict_tier_decision.timing_scope: Retrospective mass-lesion/biopsy severity annotation, not future cancer onset.
old_strict_tier_decision.blocker: Primary description counts masses, not demonstrated unique patients. No patient/lesion linkage, repeat-mass policy or patient-disjoint unit mapping was verified. Original-paper public metadata did not resolve the local cohort's repeated-mass issue; full-text access was listed as subscription.
old_strict_tier_decision.not_asserted: No assumption that 961 mass rows are 961 independent patients, and no fabricated grouped identifiers.

excluded_origins_unchanged.name: HTRU2
excluded_origins_unchanged.evidence: Original author Figshare3080389 declares GPL3.0+ while UCI displays CC-BY-4.0. The new scope tier does not authorize a license waiver or resolve the original-source conflict.

prior_decision.followup_scope: Resolve the previously pending source-unit and original-grant questions only; no repeat broad review.
prior_decision.rights_detail: UCI displays CC-BY-4.0, while the original author Figshare record declares GPL3.0+. Do not assume the host badge overrides the original grant. Private local permissions could be separately reviewed, but no new license clearance or blanket redistribution approval is issued here.
prior_decision.blocker: Rows are signal candidates averaged over rotations, not guaranteed distinct pulsars or independent observations. Original author metadata explicitly states that positional/astronomical identifiers are absent. It does not establish de-duplication of repeated candidates from the same physical source or observation.
prior_decision.not_asserted: No conversion of 1639 positive candidate examples into 1639 distinct pulsars; no fabricated observation/source groups or IID independence.
